scope: Pmatched development selection only; no confirmation data access
basis: reuse existing BASE select_references rule unchanged per pilot
qualification: all192 baseline_eligible flags must match actual frozen initializer/refit diagnostic qualification; no failed frame dropping
cost: same original validated A2 complete-F quote and1.1 ratio as BASE provisional screen; preserve all complete elapsed values; concurrent development time is not formal COST-02 acceptance
comparison_family: all28 unordered within-pilot recipe pairs x3 pilots =84 exploratory paired comparisons
primary: first reference returned by existing select_references per pilot
uncertainty: retain returned secondary, family representatives and all not-demonstrably-worse alternatives; not selected does not mean defeated
power: report all power violations without filtering frames or selecting pilot from outcome; simulation gate failure prevents deployable claim
confirmation: both Pfixed and Pmatched retain p1-p0,p2-p0,p1-p2; freeze primary receiver for each pilot before confirmation; no automatic new confirmation arms
failure: if no qualified budget reference, report no eligible Pmatched primary; do not substitute an unqualified/overbudget arm or silently change denominator
